segments.text: This episode is about Luke’s birthday, which Phil and Claire are determined not to mess up. His birthday always gets lost around Thanksgiving, and Luke never asks for much, so this year they decide to give him a party he’ll actually remember.

segments.text: Claire plans an arts-and-crafts table where the kids can make leather holders for their combs. Phil thinks that sounds painfully boring, so without telling her, he brings in a rock-climbing wall, a zip line, a bouncy castle, and other big attractions.

segments.text: Cameron shows up as Fizbo, the clown character he created when he was younger. Mitchell thinks the whole thing is embarrassing, and Phil is secretly terrified of clowns. On the way to the party, though, Fizbo proves surprisingly useful.
